items.q: Can SkelApp connect to my accounting software?
items.a: Yes. SkelApp can connect with accounting platforms such as Zoho Books, Xero, QuickBooks and Sage so sales and payment records stay easier to reconcile.
Some integrations can be configured directly, while others may need a short setup with our team depending on your workflow, branch setup and data fields.

items.q: Can I use more than one integration at the same time?
items.a: Yes. You can connect accounting, messaging and SMS tools together so different parts of your business stay in sync.
We can help review your current data and advise what can be imported or synced before setup.

items.name: Zoho Books
items.summary: Send daily sales, tax totals, invoices and customer records from SkelApp into Zoho Books.
items.detail_title: Accounting that stays close to every sale
items.detail_copy: SkelApp connects with Zoho Books so your sales, payments, expenses and tax records move into accounting without rebuilding reports by hand.
items.features_text:
Daily sales sync | Push sales summaries, payment totals and branch activity into Zoho Books for faster reconciliation.
Cleaner invoices | Create invoice-ready records from sales and customer data captured at the POS.
Tax-ready records | Keep VAT and sales tax data organised so month-end work is easier to review.
Customer visibility | Connect buyers, receipts and account activity for a more complete financial view.
Less manual entry | Reduce spreadsheet copying between your POS and accounting platform.
Branch reporting | Separate sales by shop, register or team so accounting reports are easier to understand.
items.faq_text:
Can Zoho Books receive daily summaries? | Yes. We can configure SkelApp to prepare sales and payment summaries for Zoho Books workflows.
Can customer data sync too? | Customer details can be mapped during setup depending on your preferred Zoho Books structure.

items.name: Xero
items.summary: Keep sales, settlements and reporting aligned between SkelApp and Xero.
items.detail_title: Connect shop sales to Xero reporting
items.detail_copy: Use SkelApp with Xero to reduce double entry, keep payment totals visible and prepare cleaner sales records for your finance team.
items.features_text:
Sales summaries | Send structured daily or branch-level sales summaries for review in Xero.
Payment matching | Connect cash, card and mobile-money totals to make reconciliation more predictable.
Product-level context | Use POS data to understand what drove your accounting numbers.
Multi-branch clarity | Keep location-level activity organised before it reaches finance.
Audit-friendly records | Maintain clearer source records for checks, corrections and tax review.
Month-end speed | Spend less time collecting sales files from different shops and devices.
items.faq_text:
Does SkelApp replace Xero? | No. SkelApp runs your POS operations, while Xero remains your accounting system.
Can we choose what data goes to Xero? | Yes. Data mapping is reviewed during setup so the sync fits your accounting process.

items.name: QuickBooks
items.summary: Connect POS sales and payment records with QuickBooks for cleaner books.
items.detail_title: QuickBooks records powered by live POS activity
items.detail_copy: Bring SkelApp sales and payment data into QuickBooks workflows so your finance records stay closer to what happened at the counter.
items.features_text:
Sales to books | Move POS sales records toward QuickBooks without waiting for manual reports.
Payment visibility | Track cash, cards and mobile-money payment totals from the POS.
Expense context | Keep sales and cost activity easier to compare across the business.
Receipts and invoices | Use transaction data to support cleaner receipt and invoice records.
Reporting support | Give your accountant more reliable data from the point of sale.
Flexible setup | Map fields based on your chart of accounts and operating model.
items.faq_text:
Can this work with an accountant-managed QuickBooks account? | Yes. We can coordinate the setup with whoever manages your books.
Does every sale become a separate entry? | That depends on your preferred setup. Many businesses choose summaries to keep accounts clean.

items.name: Sage
items.summary: Link SkelApp sales and retail reports with Sage accounting workflows.
items.detail_copy: SkelApp helps prepare your retail data for Sage so finance teams can review activity from branches, payment channels and product categories.
items.features_text:
Branch summaries | Group sales by shop or register before sending records into accounting.
Payment breakdowns | Separate cash, card and mobile-money activity for easier checks.
Inventory context | Use POS stock and sales data to support operational reporting.
Tax support | Keep tax-sensitive sales information structured from the start.
Finance handoff | Give finance cleaner exports and mapped fields instead of raw POS notes.
Operational control | Use SkelApp for sales and Sage for accounting without disconnecting the two.
items.faq_text:
Can Sage integration support multiple shops? | Yes. Branch and register mapping can be planned during setup.
Can SkelApp export data for Sage? | Yes. Export and sync options depend on your Sage version and workflow.

items.name: WhatsApp
items.summary: Send order updates, receipts, support messages and customer follow-ups through WhatsApp.
items.detail_title: Customer conversations connected to your POS
items.detail_copy: Use WhatsApp with SkelApp to keep customers updated after purchases, send receipts, follow up on orders and support repeat business.
items.features_text:
Digital receipts | Send customers receipts and purchase confirmations through WhatsApp.
Order updates | Keep customers informed when an order is created, prepared or ready.
Support follow-up | Move from sale to customer support without losing context.
Repeat sales | Use customer history to support better follow-up and re-engagement.
Team visibility | Give staff a clearer view of customer requests linked to POS activity.
Local-first messaging | Use the channel your customers already understand and check every day.
items.faq_text:
Can SkelApp send receipts through WhatsApp? | Yes. WhatsApp can be used for receipt and order communication workflows.
Can customers message us back? | Yes, depending on the WhatsApp setup and support process you choose.

items.name: Notify Africa BulkSMS
items.summary: Send SMS alerts, promotions, payment reminders and customer updates using Notify Africa BulkSMS.
items.detail_title: Bulk SMS campaigns from real POS data
items.detail_copy: Connect SkelApp with Notify Africa BulkSMS to send targeted customer updates, promotions and transactional alerts based on activity in your shop.
items.features_text:
Customer campaigns | Send promotions to customers based on purchase history and loyalty activity.
Transactional alerts | Notify customers about orders, payments or account updates by SMS.
Bulk reach | Reach customers even when they are offline or not using smartphone apps.
Segmented lists | Build smarter groups from POS customer data for more relevant messaging.
Performance tracking | Review campaign activity alongside sales outcomes.
Local delivery | Use a messaging provider built for African markets and phone networks.
items.faq_text:
Can SMS campaigns use SkelApp customer data? | Yes. Customer segments can be prepared from SkelApp data before sending campaigns.
Can SMS be used for order alerts? | Yes. Transactional alerts can be configured as part of the integration workflow.
